paragraphs.text: Gæller No-Breath is a deceased Omenseeker from Kaldheim , who is enjoying his afterlife in the great hall of Starnheim .

Gæller No-breath was an Omenseeker , a member of a seafaring group known for their navigational skills and knowledge of the seas. Even after his death, he has a long scar across his face, described as slashing across his face like a destination marker on a map. This scar suggests a history of battles and adventures, marking him as a seasoned warrior. This also earns him the nickname "Mapmark" from Niko Aris .

Gæller No-breath is a brave and valorous individual, noted for repelling an entire Skelle raid to protect his grandson's family. He has a good sense of humor and camaraderie, engaging in banter with other warriors and enjoying the lively atmosphere of the hall in Starnheim . Gæller is also proud and resilient, evident in his cheerful participation in the feast and his willingness to drink unusual beverages like drøss, a drink made from dragon egg whites whipped into cream.

Gæller No-breath was part of a group of warriors and other esteemed individuals gathered in a grand hall in Starnheim . He engaged in convivial conversation and drinking with other notable characters such as Thura Sail-Rend and Vígniút . During the exchange, Gæller shared his achievements and participated in the light-hearted and competitive spirit of the gathering.

When Niko Aris joined their company, Gæller listened to Niko's story of defying fate and intentionally losing a competition to break free from a preordained destiny. Gæller expressed admiration for Niko's defiance against the gods , reinforcing the idea that even the gods must earn their place in Starnheim, just like mortals.
